{{Quote|Go now and destroy these vacant structures. Find the Rebels and destroy them! For the glory of the Empire!|Brady|<ref name="SEO">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68195&month=012009|text="Smoke 'Em Out"|int=Smoke 'Em Out}}</ref>}}
'''Brady''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as an [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Following the failure of [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Braedic Ekirk]] to rid [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] of vacant houses and structures, Brady was given this task instead. He met with Colonel [[Hoot]] aboard a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] and told him of his plans for doing this. Brady believed that the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] were using abandoned houses as meeting places and he believed that he could inspire Imperial troops to destroy these houses, by offering them them rewards.
